Name: Kandi the Clown
Author: GubbisWeb
Description:
This mod Adds:
-[u] One New NPC[/u]
- [u]7 NEW Heart events[/u]

Kandi the Clown is a fun new NPC of the clown variety, get to know her and why she came to town!

[b]Portraits By:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/PossiblyClown]FellowClown
[/url]﻿

[u][b]Compatability:[/b]
[/u]This Mod SHOULD be able to run with most other expansions
I tested the festivals with SVE, Ridgeside, East Scarp, and Sunberry
and I believe I got everything to work well!



[b][u]BUGS:
[/u][/b]If you should run into a bug or issue, please let me know!
Thank you!



[size=4][b][i][u]SPECIAL THANKS:
[/u][/i][/b][/size]A Special Thank you to the Stardew Valley Modding community for helping me make this mod happen, I know I probably seemed very silly with the number of questions I asked but still, the talented and wonderful individuals in the server truly helped me. For that I am truly and forever grateful and I ask that you all continue to help guide me in the future when I work on my new Mods or even update this one as I still have much to learn!
